mintAuthority.summary: MetaMask USD is an M0-backed extension with one canonical native issuance route on Ethereum. Base M issuance remains on the Ethereum MinterGateway, and Ethereum MUSD wrapping routes through the M0 SwapFacility. Linea and Monad MUSD are M0 Portal-backed representations; their token, SwapFacility, Portal, adapter, and validator controls are assessed under bridgeRouteRisk and are excluded from native Mint Authority posture.

controls.label: M0 MinterGateway backing rail
controls.capDescription: Base M issuance backing MUSD depends on approved minters, validator attestations, mint-delay review, and M0 collateral/debt checks.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294742: Blockscout confirms ContractName=MinterGateway, IsProxy=false (immutable, non-upgradeable). EIP-1967 admin and impl slots both zero. No external admin or module surface; cap governance rests with M0 TTG (POWER token holders). M0 docs describe validator attestations before minting; this review did not enumerate the live validator threshold. MinterGateway minting is bounded by approved-Minter status, collateral/debt checks, and mint-delay review before MToken mint. Per-Minter capacity can be changed by M0 TTG governance, so the cap is protocol-governed rather than immutable; MinterGateway is confirmed immutable/non-proxy and Registrar governance remains the parameter authority. At Ethereum block 26095802, canonical EIP-1967 implementation and admin slots are both zero. The official M0 deployment table identifies this address as MinterGateway; no live validator key-custody conclusion is drawn from those slots. M0 protocol documentation requires Validator collateral attestations and a mint-delay review before approved Minters create M; the live complete validator threshold remains unverified.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770417, the canonical MUSD proxy's EIP-1967 admin is ProxyAdmin 0x685e7f8c9414bfa716b254b349153e2317929ac9. ProxyAdmin owner() returns TimelockController 0x7701f4fa4592f59a6cd0e3ac1c182b3c3173c280, whose 259,200-second delay and 3-of-5 Safe proposer, executor, and canceller path govern the Ethereum native MUSD proxy. getMinDelay() returned 259,200 seconds for the Ethereum MUSD upgrade timelock. The Linea and Monad proxy implementation/admin observations remain preserved in bridgeRouteRisk controls as representation upgrade facts. At Ethereum block 26095802, the canonical token EIP-1967 admin is ProxyAdmin 0x685e7f8c9414bfa716b254b349153e2317929ac9, whose owner() is this TimelockController. getMinDelay() returns 259200 seconds. This controls upgrades, not a separate direct-mint role.

controls.label: M0 SwapFacility extension router
controls.capDescription: SwapFacility routes approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M; it can mint extension balances through wrap flows but does not create base M supply.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25531380, SwapFacility remained a TransparentUpgradeableProxy using implementation 0x45bf08d042a8958f01f8e8319b791e4584550da8. The canonical EIP-1967 admin slot 0xb5312768...d6103 returned ProxyAdmin 0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924, and the proxy runtime independently embedded the same immutable admin address. ProxyAdmin owner() returned TimelockController 0x23ca665c8a73292fc7ac2cc4493d2ce883bba468 (3-day minDelay=259200s). Timelock proposer was Gnosis Safe 0xb7a9b5f301ef3bad36c2b4964e82931dd7fb989c (5 owners, threshold 3); executor was 0xf2f1acbe0ba726fee8d75f3e32900526874740bb. SwapFacility wraps approved M0 extensions 1:1 against M and does not create base M supply; extension minting is bounded by available M-backed wrapper flow and base M supply. SwapFacility cap follows M supply and can be changed through the M0 governance/admin path rather than an immutable cap. Ethereum SwapFacility is controlled by ProxyAdmin -> TimelockController with a 3-day delay and Gnosis Safe proposer; canRaiseCap=true via M0 TTG governance. The implementation, EIP-1967 admin and ProxyAdmin owner were re-read unchanged at Ethereum block 26095802 on 2026-10-01. The MUSD audit describes approved users depositing M into SwapFacility for equivalent mUSD and reversing the flow by burning mUSD for M. At Ethereum block 26095802, the EIP-1967 admin is ProxyAdmin 0x0f38d8a5583f9316084e9c40737244870c565924. owner() returns TimelockController 0x23ca665c8a73292fc7ac2cc4493d2ce883bba468. The reviewed mUSD wrap and unwrap lifecycle exchanges equivalent M and mUSD; this is not evidence of an immutable whole-system supply ceiling.

review.evidence: The native Mint Authority scope is Ethereum only. The immutable Ethereum MinterGateway creates base M subject to approved-minter, validator-attestation, mint-delay, collateral/debt, and M0 TTG controls; Ethereum MUSD wraps that M through the SwapFacility, whose upgradeable wrapper path is governed by the reviewed Ethereum ProxyAdmin and three-day timelock. Linea and Monad MUSD/SwapFacility proxy observations, M0 Portal and Hyperlane adapter controls, peer configuration, pauses, and validator sets are representation facts preserved under bridgeRouteRisk and excluded from this native posture. ORCHESTRATOR-AUTHORIZED adverse-pin correction — owner review required; C29 process-only review 2026-10-20, original authority review start 2026-08-16 and every historical authority pin retained. Supervision is withdrawn from attestation-only to unknown: underlying per-minter validator signatures do not identify an independent recurring whole-mUSD-liability reporting party. Continuous reconciliation is independently established for the immediate native M book, not inherited offchain Treasury assurance. At Ethereum block 26236706, hash 0x8bb57ed0d97f347defc55a6d0d705b08bda8c37f58a66496505f3efdb61cc3b6, timestamp 2026-10-20T22:12:23Z, the canonical proxy resolves to fully verified MUSD implementation 0x37a309611e1d278cddc341e479957ec8bc6256ce, whose explorer deployed bytecode equals the pinned RPC runtime byte for byte. All inherited sources were reviewed: MExtension deposits the immutable M asset before nominal mint and burns before returning M; MYieldToOne's only additional mint is claimYield, bounded by max(M balance minus totalSupply,0). MUSD adds pause, freeze and forced-transfer controls, not another mint or queued liability path. The complete single-native-deployment book has 8840718361812 raw mUSD liabilities and 8841111110192 raw M held, both six decimals; mToken is 0x866a2bf4e572cbcf37d5071a7a58503bfb36be1b and swapFacility is 0xb6807116b3b1b321a390594e31ecd6e0076f6278. These onchain quantities and source-defined mint/burn/surplus paths make the whole native book continuously derivable; remote representations remain separate Bridge Risk. The known mutable native upgrade power and economicCapSemantics unbounded are retained; this mechanical accounting establishes neither prudential supervision, independent financial assurance, no-incident status nor measured exit capacity.
